import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages; w['late']=w.year>=1876
def est(d):
  m=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (m[True]-m[False]).mean()
print('est',est(w))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
g=[x for _,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
bs=[est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in g])) for _ in range(1000)]
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
# author cluster bootstrap
a=w.author_key.unique();grp={k:v for k,v in w.groupby('author_key')}
bs2=[]
for _ in range(500):
  s=rng.choice(a,len(a));bs2.append(est(pd.concat([grp[k] for k in s])))
print('auth',np.percentile(bs2,[2.5,97.5]))
print('hi/med',est(w[w.date_confidence!='low']),'1ed',est(w[w.n_editions==1]))
print('window 1846-1905',est(w[(w.year>1845)&(w.year<1906)]))
print(w.author_key.nunique(), w.groupby('author_key').size().max())
ids=p[p.domains.apply(lambda d:'DISTANCE_TRAVEL' in list(d))].merge(w[['work_id','year']],on='work_id')
print(ids.sort_values('confidence',ascending=False).groupby(ids.year>=1876).head(4)[['passage_id','year','confidence']])
"
